summary: Iter 55 — Commission Rate Control + CRM Pipeline Upgrade. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (rates settings CRUD + validation, per-VA overrides CRUD + effective-config merge, override-driven digital calc = $150 on $1000@15%, global-rate-driven flat calc = $35 deep, admin+VA followup/contact/comment endpoints, stage-change + lead_comment notifications to VA, cross-owner 404 gate). Frontend smoke: /ops/va-program/rates renders 16 flat rate-input-* fields + rate-commercial-pct + rate-digital-pct + rates-save-btn + rates-reset-defaults; edited deep 25→30 persisted after reload and was restored to 25; sidebar 'Rates' link present. Pipeline page: pipeline-layout-table / pipeline-layout-board toggles work; pipeline-board renders all 7 stage columns (new_lead, contacted, quoted, booked, completed, paid, lost) with 331 board-card-* cards; table layout now shows new 'Follow-up' and 'Activity' columns. Global rates + VA overrides fully cleaned up after run (deep restored to 25, VA Demo overrides cleared, 12 CRMTEST leads soft-deleted).

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside data-testid='pipeline-stage-...' select. Silent, does not crash UI, but noisy in console. Same root cause as WorkerLayout warning previously flagged.

verification_steps_all_passed: PUT commission-settings deep=35 persists on reload; rejects unknown key (400) and >100 pct (422)
GET/PUT /api/pm/vas/{id}/commission-overrides — set/clear works; unknown key → 400; bad va → 404
Override digital_pct=15 → commission=$150.00 on $1000 with calc_notes containing '15%'
Global deep=35 with no override → commission=$35 flat on deep cleaning lead through new_lead→…→paid
POST /api/pm/leads/{id}/followup sets next_followup_at + followup_note + adds 'followup_set' activity
POST /api/pm/leads/{id}/contacts increments contact_count on every call
POST /api/pm/leads/{id}/comments increments comment_count + fires kind=lead_comment notification to VA
VA can self-followup/contact/comment on own lead; foreign lead → 404 for all 3
UI: /ops/va-program/rates has 16 flat rate-input-*, commercial %, digital %, save + reset btns; deep 25→30 persists on reload; restore-to-25 works via edit+save (form path)
UI: pipeline-layout-table / pipeline-layout-board toggles present; board renders 7 board-col-* columns; table headers include Follow-up + Activity
action_items: Optional cleanup: fix React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in AdminVAPipeline stage select (same pre-existing issue as WorkerLayout — silent noise only).
critical_code_review_comments: va_commission._resolve_commission_config correctly merges hardcoded defaults ← app_settings globals ← per-VA user.commission_overrides, with commercial_pct handled as %(0..100) uniformly (converted from the stored fraction 0.05 in COMMISSION_RATES when the app_setting is absent). Clean, single source of truth for both digital and cleaning paths.
routes/pm.py PUT commission-settings validates each rate key against OVERRIDABLE_FLAT_SERVICES and rejects out-of-range values (0..10000) — good server-side safety net beyond client validation.
Per-VA override PUT is a full-replace of the overrides dict (no partial merge), matching the frontend 'Clear all' UX. Documented as such — no bug.

Stage-change notification is skipped when the new stage matches the current stage (no-op guard) and when moving to 'paid' (paid already emits its own commission-earned notification). Correct behavior.
apply_lead_comment only inserts a lead_comment notification when actor.role != 'va' and lead has va_user_id — VAs replying to themselves don't spam their own notifications. Correct.

Pipeline board renders 331 cards without visible pagination — could get sluggish once lead volume climbs into thousands. Consider a per-column limit + 'load more' or virtualization when lead count > 500. Not a blocker for launch.
Pre-existing hydration warning ('<span> in <option>') still present in AdminVAPipeline select — cosmetic only but worth cleaning up in the next UI pass.
seed_data_creation: 12 CRMTEST-* leads (all digital_other + 1 deep) created and soft-deleted at teardown. Global rates temporarily set to deep=35 during calc test then restored to deep=25. VA Demo commission_overrides temporarily set to {digital_pct:15} and {deep:40, digital_pct:15} for override tests, then cleared. Seed lead 'Acme Web Co' (lead_1b2e349427d9) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter55_rates_and_crm.py (18 tests, ~4s, self-cleaning). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env fallback. VA notifications endpoint /api/notifications returns a bare list (not {items:[...]}); tests already handle both shapes. HTML5 drag&drop on the Kanban was NOT exercised via Playwright — main agent curl-verified stage transitions and board renders 331 cards cleanly; suggest a manual smoke of drag→drop + prompt-on-completed→paid before shipping. Rates page 'Reset to defaults' button restores form values only (not auto-persisted) — user must click Save after; tested restore flow manually via edit+save.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Two initial test failures were due to tests assuming {items:[...]} shape for /api/notifications when it actually returns a bare list; fixed in-test.
